text: Karen was a high school student who disliked school and maintained barely passing grades. A few weeks before the end of the year, her father promised to take her to Hawaii if she passed all of her classes. After hearing this promise, Karen spent the rest of the year daydreaming about going to Hawaii instead of studying. As a result, she failed her classes and did not get to go to Hawaii. Karen was deeply disappointed and cried in her room, but her father did not take her to Hawaii.
